latestVersion.changelog:
alibabacloud-alert-intent-router v0.0.1-beta.1

- Initial release of the Alibaba Cloud alert intent routing skill.
- Parses alert messages and extracts key parameters.
- Queries CMDB for resource relationships.
- Classifies intent and routes to database, network reachability, or ECS diagnostics skills.
- Enforces pre-checks for backend skill installation and resource existence.
- Generates structured root cause analysis reports after backend diagnostics.
